patronOf.en-US: The chalice and the priest's fingers are purified
patronOf.pt-BR: O cálice e os dedos do sacerdote são purificados

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Grant, O Lord, that what we have taken with our mouth, we may receive with a pure mind; and from a temporal gift may it become to us an eternal remedy.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Que conservemos com pureza de coração, Senhor, o que a boca acaba de receber; e que esta dádiva temporal se torne para nós remédio sempiterno.

meta.basis: After receiving the Precious Blood the priest says Quod ore sumpsimus and holds out the chalice to the server at the epistle corner, 'quo vinum fundente, se purificat: deinde vino et aqua abluit pollices et indices super Calicem, quos abstergit Purificatorio, interim dicens: Corpus tuum, Domine, quod sumpsi' (Ritus servandus X.5; Fortescue, l. 5352–5362). The card shows the second ablution, over the fingers.
